name: Sel
summary: World of Elantris, where magic depends on geographic location and belief systems.

investiture.name: AonDor
investiture.summary: Symbol-based magic tied to the geography of Arelon. Weakened after the Reod.

investiture.name: Dakhor
investiture.summary: Bone-based magic used by the Fjordell priesthood. Powered by blood sacrifices.

investiture.name: Forgery
investiture.summary: Altering an object's past through seals. Most potent in MaiPon.

investiture.name: ChayShan
investiture.summary: Martial-art-based investiture from Hrovell. Channeled through precise movements.
